lines.text: Hey. Before Airbnb walks in to brief us —
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Let me take you back. Three years ago. Uber. My second project as an analyst.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: My VP — Priya — walks into our standup. Coffee in one hand. And drops this:
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Rider support cost. Cut it twenty percent. By Q3.
lines.speaker: priya

lines.text: I almost did the rookie thing.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Opened the expense sheet. Started cutting line items.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Marco — my mentor — stopped me. Looked at the screen and said —
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: 'You don't actually know what she meant yet. The real question has three parts.'
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: First — which costs?
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Rider support is a giant bucket. Refunds. Routing. Agent salaries. Tooling.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: We picked the part bleeding fastest — inbound call volume.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Different target — totally different project.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Second — how?
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: There are really only a few ways to actually cut a cost.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Change the process. Switch the vendor. Do less of it. Or automate.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Same target. Four wildly different projects.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Third — how will we know it worked?
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: You need a number. A direction. A deadline.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Marco wrote it on the board for me — cost per trip, down twenty percent, by end of Q3.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Without that — you can't tell if you actually won. Or just looked busy.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Now — watch this. It matters more than it looks.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Cut a million in support spend? On paper, that's a win.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: But — if service had gotten worse, riders would've churned. Three million in lifetime value, gone.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Same move. Very different answers.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: That's why all three. Every time.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: That's the frame I used at Uber. We'll get to how it played out, later.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: But — Airbnb is coming in to brief us in a couple of minutes.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Before they tell us anything — we already know what we need to find out.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: These three boxes. That's the frame.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Alright — your turn.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Imagine your boss said 'reduce cost.' Write what you'd need to find out — your words.
lines.speaker: avery
